title: Origin story: Hades
description: Hades was the eldest son of Cronus and Rhea, swallowed at birth and freed by Zeus. When the brothers cast lots for the cosmos, Hades drew the underworld — not as punishment but as his rightful kingdom. He abducted Persephone to be his queen, and though stern, he was the most just and least capricious of the great gods.
